title: 第1277章 太徽剑宗第1276章 器灵
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：剑问九州第1277章太徽剑宗（..la）“这飞行法器这么猛的吗？”徐粥颇为好奇。
“你来试试。”张天真摸出几张聚气符箓，“这鬼地方诸多界域灵气稀薄的程度堪称枯竭，还好我早有准备。”
白泽对张天真竖起大拇指。如今他这副身体与本命飞剑深度绑定，只要本命飞剑还在体内，就相当于拥有一套完整的丹田经络图，目下倒是不必再理会那尊拖后腿的元婴。
交谈之间，白泽得知徐粥本是和文庙小夫子等人同行。星宇浩瀚，他们走传送阵时，意外发现了天幕巨兽的秘密，小夫子便提议抓一头天幕巨兽当坐骑，用来横渡星域虚空。
结果便是抓捕失败，徐粥被那头十分方正的古怪巨兽直接带到了桓垣悬臂星域。
小夫子人都傻了。
这墨家钜子不得把他们文庙给拆了？
“还好有我。”白泽笑道，“否则你们岂不是得沦落成刑徒，在这浩瀚荒域不知漂流到何年何月。”
徐粥认真道：“大不了就苟到能抓捕天幕巨兽为止。”
三人紧赶慢赶，驾驭青舟横渡星域，一路曲折，自不必提。这一日，青舟破开虚空，降临一处未知地界。
此方地界水秀山青，天地灵气颇为馥郁，万物竞发，一派勃勃生机的景象。
时值清晨，日月同天。
只是与九州天下不同，此处世界，一眼看去，竟有三轮皓月。
徐粥大为震撼，喃喃道：“这荒域当中，果真有如九州一般的地方！天地灵气充沛，大道枷锁这般轻松！”
“说真的，你们说那些莫名其妙消失在九州的老一辈陆地神仙，到底是真的坐化了，还是破开天幕，来到了‘这里’，继续追寻长生大道了？”张天真怀疑道。
“呵呵。”白泽笑道，“太白道君，那你有没有想过，九州天幕之上，也有亿兆星辰。这所谓的‘荒域’，是否是你在中州矫首昂视能够看到的那片天？”
“青阳真君，似乎是话里有话。”张天真微笑道。
徐粥烦躁道：“儒家那帮家伙已经够不说人话了，我看你们道门也没差哪去。”
“正事要紧。”白泽收敛神色，取出星引罗盘，“既然有人流落在此，不管是不是小师姐，先找到再说。想要一探究竟，停留些许时日，也未必不可。”
“前提是那人是泠霜子才行，对吧？”张天真打趣道。

“小天师说笑了。”白泽说道，“我倒是巴不得他们都被扔到了这里，省得去找。”
白泽收起青舟，三人御空而行，根据星引罗盘的指引，速度极快，穿越广阔云海，横渡万里，赶在第三轮月亮落下山岭时，终于清晰捕捉到了另一个星引罗盘的气机。
张天真拧起眉头，下意识看了白泽一眼。
不对劲。
而那道人此刻也已经意识到问题。
星引罗盘的气机对了，人不对！
出事了。
白泽眼眸微沉，笼在道袍之下的左手微微掐指，顿时脸色难看起来。
那缕气机，沾染有吴霜的印记。
血光极重！
与此同时，万脊山脉深处，兽王岭。
太徽剑宗一行十人，身形或多或少都有几分狼狈。其中一名女子剑修神色凝重，对为首的中岁男子说道：“师兄，找到这里，始终发现不了新的线索，会不会那人已经被这里的兽王吃掉了？”
兽王。
一众修士眼底俱是闪过惧意。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1277 of Sword Asking Nine Provinces Taihui Sword Sect (..la) "Is this flying magic weapon so powerful?" Xu Zhou was quite curious.
"Come and try." Zhang Tianzhen took out a few Qi Gathering Talismans, "The spiritual energy of many realms in this ghost place is so thin that it can be called exhausted. Fortunately, I was prepared."
Bai Ze gave Zhang Tianzhen a thumbs up. Now his body is deeply bound to the natal flying sword. As long as the natal flying sword is still in the body, it is equivalent to having a complete set of Dantian meridian diagrams. For now, there is no need to pay attention to the Nascent Soul that is holding him back.
During the conversation, Bai Ze learned that Xu Zhou was traveling with the young master of the Confucian Temple and others. The stars are vast. When they were walking in the teleportation formation, they accidentally discovered the secret of the giant sky beast. The young master proposed to capture a giant sky beast as a mount to use it to cross the void of the star field.
The result was that the capture failed, and Xu Zhou was taken directly to the Huanyuan Cantilever Star Territory by the strange and square beast.
The young lady was all stupid.
Isn't this Mohist man allowed to demolish their Confucian Temple?
"It's a good thing you have me." Bai Ze said with a smile, "Otherwise, you would have to become prisoners, drifting in this vast wilderness for who knows how long."
Xu Zhou said seriously: "The worst case scenario is to survive until we can capture the giant beast of the sky."
The three of them hurriedly and slowly drove the green boat across the star field. Needless to say, there were twists and turns along the way. On this day, Qingzhou broke through the void and landed in an unknown land.
The boundary of this place is beautiful with beautiful water and green mountains, the aura of heaven and earth is quite fragrant, and all things are competing, creating a scene of great vitality.
It was early morning, and the sun and moon were in the same sky.
It's just different from the world of Jiuzhou. At a glance, there are three bright moons in the world here.
Xu Zhou was greatly shocked and murmured: "In this wilderness, it really is like a place like Kyushu! The heaven and earth are full of spiritual energy, and the shackles of the avenue are so easy!"
"Seriously, do you think those older generation land gods who disappeared inexplicably in Kyushu really passed away, or did they break through the sky and come 'here' to continue pursuing the road to immortality?" Zhang Tianzhen asked doubtfully.
"Haha." Bai Ze said with a smile, "Taojun Taibai, have you ever thought that there are billions of stars above the sky of Kyushu? Is this so-called 'Desolate Realm' the sky you can see when you raise your head and look up in Zhongzhou?"
"True Lord Qingyang, it seems there is something in his words." Zhang Tianzhen said with a smile.
Xu Zhou said irritably: "Those Confucian guys are already rude enough. I think your Taoist sect is not far behind."
"Business matters." Bai Ze calmed down and took out the star compass, "Since there is someone wandering here, whether it is the young senior sister or not, we need to find it first. If you want to find out, it is not necessary to stay for a while."
"The prerequisite is that the person is Ling Shuangzi, right?" Zhang Tianzhen joked.
"Little Heavenly Master is joking." Bai Ze said, "I wish they were all thrown here, so I don't have to look for them."
Bai Ze put away the green boat, and the three of them flew in the air. Following the guidance of the star-guided compass, they crossed the vast sea of clouds at extremely fast speeds and crossed thousands of miles. Just when the third moon set over the mountains, they finally clearly captured the energy of another star-guided compass.
Zhang Tianzhen frowned and glanced at Bai Ze subconsciously.
Something is wrong.
And the Taoist was already aware of the problem at this moment.
The qi mechanism of the Star Guide Compass is right, but the people are wrong!
Something happened.
Bai Ze's eyes darkened slightly, his left hand under the Taoist robe pinched his fingers slightly, and his face suddenly turned ugly.
That wisp of energy was stained with Wu Shuang's mark.
The bloody light is extremely heavy!
At the same time, deep in the Ten Thousand Ridges Mountains, there was the Beast King Ridge.
The Taihui Sword Sect's group of ten people were all in a more or less embarrassing shape. One of the female sword cultivators looked solemn and said to the middle-aged man in the lead: "Senior brother, I still can't find any new clues when I find this place. Could it be that that person has been eaten by the beast king here?"
Beast King.
Fear flashed in the eyes of all the monks.
